description.text: A starter deck built around Deoxys ex, released on 1 July 2004 alongside the Clash of the Blue Sky expansion, whose theme was the films Destiny Deoxys and Jirachi: Wish Maker. It is a ready-built 30-card half deck with a coin, a sheet of paper damage counters and markers, and a rule book, so two players could each buy one and play straight away.
